title: Professional Email Bundle Credit Schedule for Early Web Hosting Plans Renewals
content:
### Bundle credit schedule — Professional Email (early hosting renewals)

**Clause.** The early renewal amount of a Web Hosting Plans plan is reduced by a mail bundle credit when a Harborline email subscription (Professional Email) in status active serves the plan's primary domain: USD 20.00 when that subscription has at least 5 seats, USD 10.00 when it has fewer; a plan whose primary domain has no active Harborline email subscription receives no mail bundle credit.

**Condition, judgement, result.**

- *Condition:* an active Professional Email subscription whose email domain is the plan's primary domain.
- *Judgement:* its seat count against 5.
- *Result:* 5 or more seats — USD 20.00; 1 to 4 seats — USD 10.00; no such active subscription — no mail bundle credit.

**Hypothetical cases.** 12 seats: USD 20.00. 5 seats: USD 20.00. 2 seats: USD 10.00. A subscription on another domain only: none.
